title: BatchUploadResult
description: Result of one `attachment upload` fanned out over two or more bugs. A single-bug upload emits `upload-result` instead. Any `failed[]` entry means exit 11; a `failed[]` entry carrying `step: "comment_private"` means the attachment was created (the bug is also listed in `uploaded`) and only the follow-up comment-privacy flip failed. A `comment_private` failure stops the fan-out to further bugs; each bug the stop left untried gets its own `failed[]` entry with `step: "not_attempted"`.

size.description: Byte length of the uploaded file. Stated once: the same file is sent to every bug.

step.description: `comment_private`: the attachment was created and only the `--comment-private` follow-up failed; do not retry with the same `--comment` text. `not_attempted`: this bug was never tried because an earlier `comment_private` failure stopped the fan-out, to avoid posting the same private comment publicly on further bugs. Absent: the upload attempt itself failed for this bug -- but that is not proof the attachment was not created (a timeout or dropped connection after the POST was accepted, or a 2xx response whose body carried no id, both surface as a bare failure); list the bug's attachments before retrying.
